outputs.headline: Scam: No Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026
outputs.summary: The claim that the government is providing free laptops to all students under a "Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026" is false and a scam.
outputs.what_post_claims: The post claims that the government is giving free laptops to all students through a "Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026".
outputs.what_is_true: The Indian government has not announced any "Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme". Messages promoting such a scheme are fake and part of a scam. While some state governments have their own laptop schemes, there is no such national scheme.
evidence_against: The Press Information Bureau (PIB) Fact Check unit stated that the claim is fake and a scam.
Alt News rated as false the claim that the Prime Minister promised to distribute free laptops.
Vishvas News confirmed that the central government has not launched any free laptop scheme for students.
outputs.sources_spoken: the Press Information Bureau, Alt News, and Vishvas News
outputs.audio_script: A post claims that the government is giving free laptops to all students through a "Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026". This claim is a scam. The Indian government has not announced any such scheme. Messages promoting this are fake and part of a scam. While some state governments have their own laptop schemes, there is no such national scheme. We are very sure about this. This information comes from the Press Information Bureau, Alt News, and Vishvas News.
card_lines: SCAM: No Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme
Claim: Government giving free laptops to students.
Fact: No such scheme announced by the central government.
Source: PIB Fact Check, Alt News, Vishvas News.
